description: Schelling Add Forward: your KEY and mailbox at the start of a session, and a dossier before you stop.

hooks.command: if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.mjs"; fi
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/record-post.mjs"; fi
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stop.mjs"; fi
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-end.mjs"; fi
